title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - AnimalGroup
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/AnimalGroup. A collection of one or multiple animals, used to conduct experiments and observations on the livestock. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (SAREF core class, not modeled here). See e.g. ex:Cow_Group_A / ex:Cow_Group_B in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figures 7-8.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AnimalGroup'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. rdfs:label (max 1 per the ttl restriction). The name of the animal group.

hasMember.description: Relationship. s4agri:hasMember some Animal (inverse: s4agri:isMemberOf). The animals that are members of this group.

isLocatedIn.description: Relationship. s4agri:isLocatedIn some geo:Feature. The physical location (e.g. a Parcel) of the animal group.

receives.description: Relationship, documented in ETSI TS 103 410-6 Table 4 as 's4agri:receives some s4agri:Intake' (the intake/consumption of substances by the group). Example value is the IRI of the s4agri:Intake named individual (saref:Property). Not formally declared as its own owl:ObjectProperty in the published v2.1.1 saref4agri.ttl, but documented in the normative TS text.

generates.description: Relationship. s4agri:generates some s4agri:Yield, subPropertyOf saref:hasProperty. 'A relation to represent the yield generated by [this entity].' Example value is the IRI of the s4agri:Yield named individual (e.g. a specific milk-yield observation series, per the ex:Cow_Group_A / MilkYield example in clause 4.3.1).
